private theorem sineSeries_measurable_bounded (a z H : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H) :
    Measurable (mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H x| ≤ M := by
  have hc : Continuous (mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x =>
      (mixedSineSeries_spatial_hasDerivAt 0 0 a z H x ha hH).continuousAt
  let M := (1 / a) * ∑' n : ℕ, weightedGaussian (Real.pi ^ 2 / 8) 0 (H / a ^ 2) n
  have hb (x : ℝ) : |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H x| ≤ M := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_add,
      one_mul, mul_one] using mixedSineSeries_weighted_bound 0 0 a z H x ha hH
  exact ⟨hc.measurable, M, (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb 0), hb⟩

theorem brownian_increment_past_hasLaw {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (T S : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (fun ω => (B (T + S) ω - B T ω, brownianUnitPath B T ω))
      ((gaussianReal 0 S).prod (brownianUnitPathLaw B T P)) P := by
  let C : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ := fun u ω => B (T + u) ω - B T ω
  have hC : IsBrownianReal C P := hB.shift T
  have hInc : HasLaw (fun ω => B (T + S) ω - B T ω) (gaussianReal 0 S) P :=
    hC.toIsPreBrownianReal.hasLaw_eval S
  have hPast : HasLaw (brownianUnitPath B T) (brownianUnitPathLaw B T P) P :=
    { aemeasurable := aemeasurable_brownianUnitPath B T P hB, map_eq := rfl }
  have hInd : IndepFun (fun ω => brownianUnitPath C S ω 1) (brownianUnitPath B T) P := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq] using
      (indepFun_shifted_unitPath B P hB T S).comp
        (ContinuousMap.measurable_eval (1 : BridgeTime)) measurable_id
  have heq : (fun ω => brownianUnitPath C S ω 1) =ᵐ[P]
      (fun ω => B (T + S) ω - B T ω) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_brownianUnitPath_eq C S P hC] with ω hp
    calc
      _ = C (S * 1) ω := hp 1
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_one]
  exact (indepFun_iff_hasLaw_prodMk_prod hInc hPast).mp
    (hInd.congr heq (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl))

brownian_sine_backward_weighted.text:
theorem brownian_sine_backward_weighted {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a z H y : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (T S : ℝ≥0) (F : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) → ℝ) (hF : Measurable F)
    (hbound : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p, |F p| ≤ M) :
    Integrable (fun ω => F (brownianUnitPath B T ω) *
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω)) P ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => F (brownianUnitPath B T ω) *
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω)) P ∧
    (∫ ω, F (brownianUnitPath B T ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω) ∂P) =
      ∫ ω, F (brownianUnitPath B T ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω) ∂P := by
  let μ := brownianUnitPathLaw B T P
  let V := brownianUnitPath B T
  let Q : ℝ × C(BridgeTime, ℝ) → ℝ := fun q =>
    F q.2 * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + q.2 1 + q.1)
  rcases sineSeries_measurable_bounded a z H ha hH with ⟨hu, M, hM0, hU⟩
  have hHS : 0 < H + (S : ℝ) := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hH S.property
  rcases sineSeries_measurable_bounded a z (H + (S : ℝ)) ha hHS with ⟨huS, M', hM'0, hU'⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hbound
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ N := (abs_nonneg (F 0)).trans (hN 0)
  have hVA : AEMeasurable V P := aemeasurable_brownianUnitPath B T P hB
  have hFV : AEMeasurable (fun ω => F (V ω)) P := hF.comp_aemeasurable hVA
  have hY (t : ℝ≥0) : AEMeasurable (fun ω => y + B t ω) P :=
    aemeasurable_const.add (hB.toIsPreBrownianReal.aemeasurable t)
  have hiL : Integrable (fun ω => F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω)) P := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hFV.mul (hu.comp_aemeasurable (hY (T + S)))).aestronglyMeasurable (N * M)
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      change ‖F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω)‖ ≤ N * M
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hN (V ω)) (hU _) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
  have hiR : Integrable (fun ω => F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω)) P := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound (hFV.mul (huS.comp_aemeasurable (hY T))).aestronglyMeasurable (N * M')
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      change ‖F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω)‖ ≤ N * M'
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hN (V ω)) (hU' _) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
  refine ⟨hiL, hiR, ?_⟩
  have hPast : HasLaw V μ P := { aemeasurable := hVA, map_eq := rfl }
  have hLaw := brownian_increment_past_hasLaw B P hB T S
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hVA).mpr inferInstance
  have heval : Measurable (fun q : ℝ × C(BridgeTime, ℝ) => y + q.2 1 + q.1) :=
    (measurable_const.add ((ContinuousMap.measurable_eval (1 : BridgeTime)).comp measurable_snd)).add measurable_fst
  have hQ : Measurable Q := (hF.comp measurable_snd).mul (hu.comp heval)
  have hQi : Integrable Q ((gaussianReal 0 S).prod μ) := by
    apply Integrable.of_bound hQ.aestronglyMeasurable (N * M)
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => by
      change ‖F q.2 * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + q.2 1 + q.1)‖ ≤ N * M
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hN q.2) (hU _) (abs_nonneg _) hN0
  have hR : Measurable (fun p : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) => F p *
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + p 1)) :=
    hF.mul (huS.comp (measurable_const.add (ContinuousMap.measurable_eval (1 : BridgeTime))))
  have hEnd : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, V ω 1 = B T ω := by
    filter_upwards [ae_brownianUnitPath_eq B T P hB] with ω hp
    calc
      _ = B (T * 1) ω := hp 1
      _ = _ := by rw [mul_one]
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, Q (B (T + S) ω - B T ω, V ω) ∂P := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hEnd] with ω hp
      change F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω) =
        F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + V ω 1 + (B (T + S) ω - B T ω))
      rw [hp]
      congr 2
      ring
    _ = ∫ q, Q q ∂(gaussianReal 0 S).prod μ := hLaw.integral_comp hQ.aestronglyMeasurable
    _ = ∫ p : C(BridgeTime, ℝ), ∫ x : ℝ, Q (x, p) ∂gaussianReal 0 S ∂μ := integral_prod_symm Q hQi
    _ = ∫ p : C(BridgeTime, ℝ), F p * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + p 1) ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
        change (∫ x : ℝ, F p * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H ((y + p 1) + x) ∂gaussianReal 0 S) = _
        rw [integral_const_mul, (sineSeries_gaussian_action a z H (y + p 1) ha hH S).2]
    _ = ∫ ω, F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + V ω 1) ∂P :=
      (hPast.integral_comp hR.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
    _ = _ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hEnd] with ω hp
      change F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + V ω 1) = _
      rw [hp]

physical_survival_ae_unitPath.text:
private theorem physical_survival_ae_unitPath {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a} =ᵐ[P]
      (brownianUnitPath B T) ⁻¹'
        {p : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) | ‖ContinuousMap.const BridgeTime y + p‖ < a} := by
  filter_upwards [ae_brownianUnitPath_eq B T P hB] with ω hp
  apply propext
  change (∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a) ↔
    ‖ContinuousMap.const BridgeTime y + brownianUnitPath B T ω‖ < a
  rw [ContinuousMap.norm_lt_iff_of_nonempty]
  have hp' (t : BridgeTime) : brownianUnitPath B T ω t =
      B (T * ⟨(t : ℝ), t.property.1⟩) ω := hp t
  simp only [ContinuousMap.add_apply, ContinuousMap.const_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, hp']
  by_cases hT : T = 0
  · subst T
    constructor
    · intro h t
      let u : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(t : ℝ), t.property.1⟩
      change |y + B ((0 : ℝ≥0) * u) ω| < a
      rw [zero_mul]
      exact h 0 le_rfl
    · intro h s hs
      have he : s = 0 := le_antisymm hs zero_le
      subst s
      have ht := h (0 : BridgeTime)
      change |y + B ((0 : ℝ≥0) * 0) ω| < a at ht
      simpa only [zero_mul] using ht
  · have hTpos : 0 < (T : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hT : 0 < T)
    constructor
    · intro h t
      apply h
      let u : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(t : ℝ), t.property.1⟩
      change T * u ≤ T
      have hu : u ≤ 1 := by
        apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
        exact t.property.2
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ T from zero_le)
    · intro h s hsT
      let t : BridgeTime := ⟨(s : ℝ) / (T : ℝ), div_nonneg s.property T.property,
        (div_le_one hTpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hsT)⟩
      let u : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(t : ℝ), t.property.1⟩
      have heq : T * u = s := by
        apply NNReal.eq
        change (T : ℝ) * ((s : ℝ) / (T : ℝ)) = (s : ℝ)
        field_simp
      have ht := h t
      change |y + B (T * u) ω| < a at ht
      simpa only [heq] using ht

strict_survival_nullMeasurable.text:
theorem strict_survival_nullMeasurable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a y : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    NullMeasurableSet {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a} P := by
  have hN : MeasurableSet {p : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) |
      ‖ContinuousMap.const BridgeTime y + p‖ < a} :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.add continuous_id).norm continuous_const).measurableSet
  exact ((aemeasurable_brownianUnitPath B T P hB).nullMeasurableSet_preimage hN).congr
    (physical_survival_ae_unitPath B P hB a y T).symm

private theorem sine_restrict_integrable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a z H y : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (t : ℝ≥0) (E : Set Ω) (hE : NullMeasurableSet E P) :
    Integrable (E.indicator (fun ω => mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B t ω))) P := by
  have hi := (brownian_sine_backward_weighted B P hB a z H y ha hH 0 t
    (fun _ : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) => (1 : ℝ)) measurable_const ⟨1, fun _ => by norm_num⟩).1
  have hi' : Integrable (fun ω => mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B t ω)) P := by
    simpa only [zero_add, one_mul] using hi
  exact (integrable_indicator_iff₀ hE).mpr hi'.integrableOn

brownian_sine_survival_mask.text:
theorem brownian_sine_survival_mask {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a z H y : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H) (T S : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ ω in {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a},
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω) ∂P) =
    ∫ ω in {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a},
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω) ∂P := by
  let E : Set Ω := {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ T → |y + B s ω| < a}
  let V := brownianUnitPath B T
  let N : Set C(BridgeTime, ℝ) := {p | ‖ContinuousMap.const BridgeTime y + p‖ < a}
  let F : C(BridgeTime, ℝ) → ℝ := N.indicator (fun _ => 1)
  have hN : MeasurableSet N :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.add continuous_id).norm continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hF : Measurable F := measurable_const.indicator hN
  have hb : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p, |F p| ≤ M := by
    refine ⟨1, fun p => ?_⟩
    by_cases hp : p ∈ N
    · simp only [F, Set.indicator_of_mem hp, abs_one, le_refl]
    · simp only [F, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, abs_zero, zero_le_one]
  have hE : NullMeasurableSet E P := strict_survival_nullMeasurable B P hB a y T
  have hAE : E =ᵐ[P] V ⁻¹' N := physical_survival_ae_unitPath B P hB a y T
  have hind (g : Ω → ℝ) : (fun ω => F (V ω) * g ω) =ᵐ[P] E.indicator g := by
    filter_upwards [hAE] with ω hω
    have hh : ω ∈ E ↔ V ω ∈ N := Iff.of_eq hω
    by_cases hp : V ω ∈ N
    · have he : ω ∈ E := hh.mpr hp
      change N.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (V ω) * g ω = E.indicator g ω
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem he, one_mul]
    · have he : ω ∉ E := fun h => hp (hh.mp h)
      change N.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (V ω) * g ω = E.indicator g ω
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem he, zero_mul]
  calc
    _ = ∫ ω, E.indicator (fun ω => mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω)) ω ∂P :=
      (integral_indicator₀ hE).symm
    _ = ∫ ω, F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B (T + S) ω) ∂P :=
      integral_congr_ae (hind _).symm
    _ = ∫ ω, F (V ω) * mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω) ∂P :=
      (brownian_sine_backward_weighted B P hB a z H y ha hH T S F hF hb).2.2
    _ = ∫ ω, E.indicator (fun ω => mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (S : ℝ)) (y + B T ω)) ω ∂P :=
      integral_congr_ae (hind _)
    _ = _ := integral_indicator₀ hE

brownian_sine_finite_stopped_mesh.text:
theorem brownian_sine_finite_stopped_mesh {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (a z H y : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H)
    (hy : |y| < a) (δ : ℝ≥0) (N : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω in {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ (N : ℝ≥0) * δ → |y + B s ω| < a},
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z H (y + B ((N : ℝ≥0) * δ) ω) ∂P) =
      mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + (N : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ)) y -
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
          ∫ ω in {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ (k : ℝ≥0) * δ → |y + B s ω| < a} \
              {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * δ → |y + B s ω| < a},
            mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z (H + ((N - (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ))
              (y + B (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * δ) ω) ∂P := by
  let V (k : ℕ) : Set Ω := {ω | ∀ s : ℝ≥0, s ≤ (k : ℝ≥0) * δ → |y + B s ω| < a}
  let R (k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℝ := mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z
    (H + ((N - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ)) (y + B ((k : ℝ≥0) * δ) ω)
  let A (k : ℕ) : ℝ := ∫ ω in V k, R k ω ∂P
  let D (k : ℕ) : ℝ := ∫ ω in V k \ V (k + 1), R (k + 1) ω ∂P
  have hV (k : ℕ) : NullMeasurableSet (V k) P :=
    strict_survival_nullMeasurable B P hB a y ((k : ℝ≥0) * δ)
  have hR (k : ℕ) : 0 < H + ((N - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ) :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hH (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) δ.property)
  have hsub (k : ℕ) : V (k + 1) ⊆ V k := by
    intro ω hω s hs
    apply hω s
    apply hs.trans
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ k) (show (0 : ℝ≥0) ≤ δ from zero_le)
  have htime (k : ℕ) : (k : ℝ≥0) * δ + δ = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * δ := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hstep (k : ℕ) (hk : k < N) : A (k + 1) + D k = A k := by
    have hn : N - k = N - (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hcut : H + ((N - (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ) =
        H + ((N - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ) := by
      rw [hn, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      ring
    have hm := brownian_sine_survival_mask B P hB a z
      (H + ((N - (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ)) y ha (hR (k + 1)) ((k : ℝ≥0) * δ) δ
    rw [htime k, hcut] at hm
    change (∫ ω in V k, R (k + 1) ω ∂P) = A k at hm
    have hi1 : Integrable ((V (k + 1)).indicator (R (k + 1))) P :=
      sine_restrict_integrable B P hB a z _ y ha (hR (k + 1)) _ _ (hV (k + 1))
    have hi2 : Integrable ((V k \ V (k + 1)).indicator (R (k + 1))) P :=
      sine_restrict_integrable B P hB a z _ y ha (hR (k + 1)) _ _ ((hV k).diff (hV (k + 1)))
    have hind (ω : Ω) : (V (k + 1)).indicator (R (k + 1)) ω +
        (V k \ V (k + 1)).indicator (R (k + 1)) ω = (V k).indicator (R (k + 1)) ω := by
      by_cases hn : ω ∈ V (k + 1)
      · have hp := hsub k hn
        simp [Set.indicator, hn, hp]

private theorem low_sineSeries_strip_bound (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 1) (a z H : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ U : ℝ, H ≤ U → ∀ x : ℝ, ‖mixedSineSeries j 0 a z U x‖ ≤ C := by
  let A : ℝ := (1 / a) * (Real.pi / (2 * a)) ^ j
  let W : ℕ → ℝ := weightedGaussian (Real.pi ^ 2 / 8) j (H / a ^ 2)
  let C : ℝ := A * ∑' n : ℕ, W n
  have hW : Summable W := weightedGaussian_summable (Real.pi ^ 2 / 8) (H / a ^ 2) j
    (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hb (U : ℝ) (hHU : H ≤ U) (x : ℝ) : ‖mixedSineSeries j 0 a z U x‖ ≤ C := by
    have hs := mixedSineTerm_summable j 0 a z U x ha (hH.trans_le hHU)
    have ht (n : ℕ) : ‖mixedSineTerm j 0 a z U x n‖ ≤ A * W n := by
      simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, pow_zero, mul_one] using
        mixedSineTerm_strip_bound j 0 a z H U x n ha hHU
    exact hs.hasSum.norm_le_of_bounded (hW.hasSum.mul_left A) ht
  exact ⟨C, (norm_nonneg _).trans (hb H le_rfl 0), hb⟩

theorem sineSeries_zero_walls (a z U : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U (-a) = 0 ∧ mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U a = 0 := by
  change (∑' n : ℕ, mixedSineTerm 0 0 a z U (-a) n) = 0 ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, mixedSineTerm 0 0 a z U a n) = 0
  simp only [mixedSineTerm, iteratedDeriv_zero]
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = ∑' _n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) := tsum_congr fun n => by simp [sineTerm]
      _ = 0 := tsum_zero
  · have hz (n : ℕ) : sineTerm a z U a n = 0 := by
      have he : frequency a n * (a + a) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.pi := by
        dsimp only [frequency]
        push_cast

    calc
      _ = ∑' _n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) := tsum_congr hz
      _ = 0 := tsum_zero

theorem sineSeries_uniform_bounded_lipschitz (a z H : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H) :
    ∃ M L : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ U : ℝ, H ≤ U →
      (∀ x : ℝ, |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U x| ≤ M) ∧
      ∀ x y : ℝ, |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U x - mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U y| ≤ L * |x - y| := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := low_sineSeries_strip_bound 0 (by norm_num) a z H ha hH
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hL⟩ := low_sineSeries_strip_bound 1 (by norm_num) a z H ha hH
  refine ⟨M, L, hM0, hL0, fun U hHU => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro x
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hM U hHU x
  · intro x y
    have hh := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (f := mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U) (f' := mixedSineSeries 1 0 a z U)
      (s := (univ : Set ℝ)) (x := y) (y := x)
      (fun w _ => (mixedSineSeries_spatial_hasDerivAt 0 0 a z U w ha (hH.trans_le hHU)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun w _ => hL U hHU w) convex_univ (mem_univ y) (mem_univ x)
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hh

theorem sineSeries_uniform_wall_bound (a z H : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hH : 0 < H) :
    ∃ M L : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ U : ℝ, H ≤ U → ∀ x : ℝ,
      |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U x| ≤ M ∧
      |mixedSineSeries 0 0 a z U x| ≤ L * abs (abs x - a) := by
  obtain ⟨M, L, hM0, hL0, hb⟩ := sineSeries_uniform_bounded_lipschitz a z H ha hH
  refine ⟨M, L, hM0, hL0, fun U hHU x => ⟨(hb U hHU).1 x, ?_⟩⟩
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · have hh := (hb U hHU).2 x a
    rw [(sineSeries_zero_walls a z U ha).2, sub_zero] at hh
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg hx] using hh
  · have hh := (hb U hHU).2 x (-a)
    rw [(sineSeries_zero_walls a z U ha).1, sub_zero] at hh
    have he : |x - (-a)| = abs (abs x - a) := by
      rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hx), show -x - a = -(x - (-a)) by ring, abs_neg]
    rw [he] at hh
    exact hh

In this file we define two predicates over stochastic processes `X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ` given
a probability measure `P : Measure Ω`. `IsPreBrownianReal X P` means that
`X` is a pre-Brownian motion. It means that it has the law of the Brownian motion, namely that
its finite dimensional distributions are given by `projectiveFamily`. Then
`IsBrownianReal X P` means that `X` is a Brownian motion, which means that it is a pre-Brownian
motion with almost surely continuous paths.

We prove that a centered Gaussian process `X` with covariances given by `cov[X s, X t; P] = min s t`
is a pre-Brownian motion and provide basic invariance properties. We also prove the
weak Markov property: if `B` is a pre-Brownian motion and `t₀ : ℝ≥0`, then the process
`t ↦ B (t + t₀) - B t₀` is a pre-Brownian motion independent from `(B t | t ≤ t₀)`.

## Main definitions

* `IsPreBrownianReal X P`: A stochastic process is called pre-Brownian if its finite-dimensional
  laws are those of the Brownian motion, see `projectiveFamily`.
* `IsBrownianReal X P`: A stochastic process is called Brownian if its finite-dimensional laws
  are those of the Brownian motion, see `IsPreBrownianReal`,
  and if it has almost-surely continuous paths.

## Main statements

* `IsGaussianProcess.isPreBrownianReal_of_covariance`: A centered Gaussian process with the right
  covariance is a pre-Brownian motion.
* `HasIndepIncrements.isPreBrownianReal_of_hasLaw`: A stochastic process `X` with independent
  increments and such that for all `t`, `X t` has law `gaussianReal 0 t` is a pre-Brownian motion.
* `IsPreBrownianReal.indepFun_shift`: The weak Markov property: If `B` is a pre-Brownian motion,
  then `B (t₀ + t) - B t₀` is a pre-Brownian motion which is independent from `(B t, t ≤ t₀)`.

## Tags

pre-Brownian motion, Brownian motion, Markov property

-/

variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {B X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} {P : Measure Ω}

namespace ProbabilityTheory

section IsPreBrownianReal

/-! ### Pre-Brownian motion -/

/-- A stochastic process is called **pre-Brownian** if its finite-dimensional laws are those
of the Brownian motion, see `projectiveFamily`.

Note: we name the constructor `mk'` so as to define later `IsPreBrownianReal.mk`, which to
pre-Brownian motion will associate a continuous modification,
in a way similar to `AEMeasurable.mk`. -/
structure IsPreBrownianReal (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω := by volume_tac) : Prop where
  mk' ::
  hasLaw : ∀ I : Finset ℝ≥0, HasLaw (fun ω ↦ I.restrict (X · ω)) (projectiveFamily I) P

/-- A modification of a pre-Brownian process is pre-Brownian. -/
lemma IsPreBrownianReal.congr {C : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P)
    (h : ∀ t, B t =ᵐ[P] C t) :
    IsPreBrownianReal C P where
  hasLaw I := by
    refine (hB.hasLaw I).congr ?_
    have : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ i : I, B i ω = C i ω := ae_all_iff.2 fun _ ↦ h _
    filter_upwards [this] with ω hω using funext fun i ↦ (hω i).symm

lemma IsPreBrownianReal.isGaussianProcess (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P) : IsGaussianProcess B P where
  hasGaussianLaw I := (hB.hasLaw I).hasGaussianLaw

lemma IsPreBrownianReal.aemeasurable (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    AEMeasurable (B t) P :=
  HasGaussianLaw.aemeasurable (hB.isGaussianProcess.hasGaussianLaw_eval t)

lemma IsPreBrownianReal.hasLaw_eval (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P) (t : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (B t) (gaussianReal 0 t) P :=
  (measurePreserving_eval_projectiveFamily ⟨t, by simp⟩).hasLaw.comp (hB.hasLaw {t})

lemma IsPreBrownianReal.eval_zero_ae_eq_zero (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, B 0 ω = 0 := by
  have := hB.hasLaw_eval 0
  rw [gaussianReal_zero_var] at this
  exact this.ae_eq_of_dirac

lemma IsPreBrownianReal.hasLaw_sub (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B P) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (B s - B t) (gaussianReal 0 (nndist s.1 t.1)) P :=
  (measurePreserving_eval_sub_eval_projectiveFamily
    {s, t} ⟨s, by simp⟩ ⟨t, by simp⟩).hasLaw.comp (hB.hasLaw _)

section IsBrownianReal

/-! ### Brownian motion -/

variable {B X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}

/-- A stochastic process is called **Brownian** if its finite-dimensional laws are those
of the Brownian motion, see `IsPreBrownianReal`, and if it has almost-surely continuous paths. -/
structure IsBrownianReal (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (P : Measure Ω := by volume_tac) : Prop
    extends IsPreBrownianReal X P where
  cont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Continuous (X · ω)

lemma IsBrownianReal.neg (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) :
    IsBrownianReal (-B) P where
  toIsPreBrownianReal := hB.toIsPreBrownianReal.neg
  cont := hB.cont.mono (fun _ _ ↦ by simpa [← Pi.neg_def, continuous_neg_iff])

/-- If `B` is a Brownian motion and `c > 0`, then `t ↦ (√c)⁻¹ B (c t)` is a Brownian motion. -/
lemma IsBrownianReal.smul (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) {c : ℝ≥0} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    IsBrownianReal (fun t ω ↦ (√c)⁻¹ * B (c * t) ω) P where
  toIsPreBrownianReal := hB.toIsPreBrownianReal.smul hc
  cont := by
    filter_upwards [hB.cont] with ω h
    fun_prop

lemma IsBrownianReal.shift (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) (t₀ : ℝ≥0) :
    IsBrownianReal (fun t ω ↦ B (t₀ + t) ω - B t₀ ω) P where
  toIsPreBrownianReal := hB.toIsPreBrownianReal.shift t₀
  cont := by
    filter_upwards [hB.cont] with ω h
    fun_prop

lemma IsBrownianReal.tendsto_nhds_zero (hB : IsBrownianReal B P) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (B · ω) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
  filter_upwards [hB.cont, hB.eval_zero_ae_eq_zero] with ω h1 h2
  convert h1.tendsto 0
  exact h2.symm

We say that a measure `μ` is complete w.r.t. the `MeasurableSpace α` σ-algebra (or the σ-algebra is
complete w.r.t. measure `μ`) if every set of measure zero is measurable. In this case all null
measurable sets and functions are measurable.
